title: Barber story: contractor and mercenary retrieval units competing

tellings.quote: also would explain the whole weird parts of the barber story where it's implies there's like contractor teams and mercenary you know you know like retrieval units all kind of competing over this stuff.

plain: Part of the account of a man named Jake Barber suggests that private contractor teams and mercenary retrieval units, groups that recover crashed objects, are competing with each other to get hold of them. A guest named Matthew Pines brings this up with Michels in passing. He calls these 'the whole weird parts of the barber story,' and says his own view of things would explain them.
